title: Explain a delay to a manager
description: Give your manager a status update on late work, lead with the facts, and commit to a date.

brief.scene: Your manager has asked for a status update on {{thing}}, which is behind schedule.
brief.yourGoal: Lead with the facts, not the excuse, and finish with a commitment.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Ask for a status update on {{thing}}. One sentence only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Ask when it will be done. One short sentence only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

judged.label: Facts first, then a commitment
judged.criterion: The first answer leads with the fact that the work is late and by how much, not with excuses. The second answer ends with a specific commitment, a date or a clear next milestone.

criteriaDisplay: Keep filler words under 4 per minute
Speak between 120 and 170 words per minute
Finish between 35 seconds and 2 min 20 sec
Lead with the fact, not the excuse, and end with a date
